title: sflib: A Go library for biodiversity archive formats
description: sflib provides a unified interface for working with biodiversity data across five archive formats: plain text, CSV/TSV/PSV, CoLDP, Darwin Core Archive (DwCA), and Species File Group Archive (SFGA). The Catalogue of Life Data Package (CoLDP) is used as the shared internal data model.
